title: Roswell, NM — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Roswell, NM: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Roswell is a city in NM with a population of 48,000. UFO capital of the world with the International UFO Museum and a strong aerospace sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year.
